hooks.command: docker exec stp-api sh -c "cd /app && ./node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -20" | python3 -c "import json,sys; o=sys.stdin.read().strip(); print(json.dumps({'hookSpecificOutput':{'hookEventName':'PostToolUse','additionalContext':'[tsc] ' + (o or 'Sin errores de TypeScript')}}))" 2>/dev/null || true

docker exec stp-api sh -c "./node_modules/.bin/ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register node_modules/typeorm/cli.js migration:show -d src/data-source.ts 2>&1 | tail -15" 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.dumps({'systemMessage': '--- Migraciones (verifica antes de commit) ---\n' + sys.stdin.read()}))" 2>/dev/null || true
docker logs stp-api --tail=20 2>&1 | python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.dumps({'systemMessage': '--- stp-api | ultimos logs ---\n' + sys.stdin.read()}))" 2>/dev/null || true
